caption: The drawing depicts two metallic objects, both resembling slotted or perforated ladles. The primary object at the bottom left is a large, round, shallow spoon with numerous small holes evenly distributed across its slightly concave surface; the bowl transitions into a straight metal handle, which is elongated and rectangular with a rounded end and a small hole near its tip, likely for hanging. The metallic surface of the spoon displays shades of brass, green, and brown, creating a patina effect. The second object, positioned above and to the right, shows a partial top-down perspective of a similar, but smaller, oval perforated spoon, with a metal handle attached by two visible rivets. The background is a plain, light beige color, and there is a small, red signature and date reading "Chas. F. Moss 1938" near the lower center of the image.
title: Skimmer
